method.alignment: Full-length global affine-gap BLOSUM62 from local UniProt flatfile sequences
method.numbering: Human auth=UniProt; all 11qc A protein atom author/label pairs verified auth-label=121; mouse=UniProt/AF PDB
method.neighbourhood: Other same-chain protein residues with any heavy atom within <=8 A of any hotspot heavy atom, human 11qc A; all domains included; hotspot excluded
method.patch_scan: Centres: identical apical residues RSA>=0.2; patch: identical RSA>=0.2 residues within CA10 A; >=5 residues. Rank by invariant fraction of union of their 8 A environments, then exposed conserved area. RSA from native dimer+observed glycans, 1.4 A probe, 200 points, Wilke maxima. Conservation-only ranking; no binding claim.

ectodomain_identity.note: Sequence-derived identity on this full ectodomain span, not the challenge approximately86% claim for its modelled region

hotspots.chemistry: Nonconservative K->S: long basic cationic side chain -> short polar hydroxyl; formal charge +1->0
Nonconservative R->N: basic guanidinium -> neutral polar amide; formal charge +1->0
Ambiguous gap or nonconservative V->D: aliphatic hydrophobe -> acidic carboxylate; formal charge 0->-1 if D

mouse_trim.warning: His710-centred discontinuous crop does not cover this epitope; full AF mouse model used

verdict: Partially conserved only: 2/5 identities; two charge-losing substitutions and one ambiguous nonconserved indel/substitution. As-is cross-reactivity remains unestablished.
limitations: Sequence/geometry and exposure only, no binding or cross-reactivity measurement
Human local neighbourhood, not a mouse side-chain recognition model
Observed glycan atoms only, no complete assay glycans or tags
All equally optimal alignments retained; human210 cannot be assigned uniquely from these sequences/settings
